en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large early-20th‑century battleship at sea, viewed from the side. The ship has multiple gun turrets, two funnels, and tall masts with rigging. Low hills or coastline are faintly visible in the background. Greek text is printed at the lower left, and French text appears near the bottom center. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is superimposed across the lower-right portion of the image.
